# Variables: for each number 1-16, assign to group 0-3

    s.add(x[i] >= 0, x[i] <= 3)

# Each group has sum 34

    sum_g = Sum([ (i+1) * (x[i] == g) for i in range(16) ])
    s.add(sum_g == 34)

# Solve

    sol = [m.evaluate(x[i]).as_long() for i in range(16)]
